title: Game of More — surface-v3 material study
request: Détailler visage et corps, réduire l’aspect pâte à modeler, viser un rendu jeu vidéo moderne à partir de la référence Link fournie.
sourceCredit: Underlying game morphology and source maps: Nintendo / The Models Resource, uploaded by Trikeboy. Base-v2 character adaptation and surface-v3 authored material pass: Game of More study.
geometry: The sorted vertex positions of skin, eyes, clothing and hair are checked before and after the surface pass. They are unchanged. Hair meshes are consolidated for a shared material atlas; UVs may differ. The equipment anchors and natural pose are copied unchanged from base-v2.
skin: Source head/skin normal maps restored, upsampled and normalized with restrained surface variation. The head AO source is channel-packed: its red channel contributes only mild occlusion, not magenta RGB. Regional roughness and detailed irises replace uniform shading.
clothing: Authored cotton surface, local fold and collar cues, albedo/roughness/tangent-normal maps baked to a portable atlas. Source trouser and boot normal maps restore folds and seams; their roughness differs by material region.
hair: Fibre coordinates follow individual lock direction or crown meridians. Restrained colour and roughness variation and fine normal relief are baked into a shared 2048px atlas.
portraits: Actual Blender Cycles renders of the revised models. Soft directional studio light, 32 samples, transparent film. WebP images derive from PNG renders. Comparison mode uses common real-time lighting and synchronized cameras for both revisions.
scope: Versioned material/detail study. Validated base-v2 files and the items-update retarget are not overwritten.
